channel.title: Queen Anne & Magnolia Dispatch
channel.description: Queen Anne & Magnolia news, once a week, from the Queen Anne & Magnolia Dispatch.

item.title: The city is studying whether to repair or replace the W Dravus St Bridge, and the comment window closes Nov. 24
item.description: Built in 1935, the bridge links Magnolia, Interbay and Queen Anne over BNSF's Balmer Yard and carries more than 21,000 vehicles a day.

item.title: Budget committee votes start Friday, Nov. 13; the final council vote is Nov. 20
item.description: The Budget Chair's balancing package, released Nov. 3, amends the mayor's proposed 2027–2028 budget.

item.title: Climate Pledge Arena has six events in eight nights
item.description: Garth Brooks plays four shows: tonight at 7:30, Friday and Saturday at 8, and a 2 p.m.

item.title: get the pipes ready before the first freeze
item.description: Find your main water shutoff now, before you need it; it is usually in a basement, crawlspace or garage.

item.title: When light rail will actually reach Interbay and Ballard
item.description: A reader asked when light rail will actually reach Interbay and Ballard.

item.title: The council's budget package has a public hearing today, and a final vote on Nov. 20
item.description: Budget Chair Dan Strauss is scheduled to release a proposed balancing package on Nov. 3, and the council's calendar puts the proposed package on Nov. 4 at 9:30 a.m.

item.title: Climate Pledge Arena has events on five nights between Nov. 5 and Nov. 12
item.description: Concerts are listed for Nov. 5, 6, 10 and 12, and a Kraken hockey game for Nov. 7.

item.title: clear the storm drain before the rain
item.description: Before the wet weather arrives, rake leaves off the lawn before they reach the storm drain.

item.title: How to get a load of groceries home by rideshare or bus from the Queen Anne grocery stores
item.description: A reader on Queen Anne asked how to get a load of groceries home by rideshare or bus from the Queen Anne grocery stores.

item.title: SDOT's draft plan puts 2-hour paid parking on Queen Anne Avenue North in 2027
item.description: It covers Queen Anne Avenue North from West Galer Street to McGraw Street plus parts of Boston and Crockett streets, 8 AM to 8 PM, Monday to Saturday, at a proposed $1 an hour until 11 AM and $4 after.

item.title: Mercer Street's bus upgrades could start construction in 2027; the D Line schedule holds until March
item.description: SDOT's Harrison and Mercer Transit Access Project may add bus lanes, new and upgraded stops and bus signal timing on Mercer Street between Queen Anne Avenue North and 5th Avenue North.

item.title: Clocks fall back at 2 AM Sunday, November 1
item.description: Seattle Fire's advice for that weekend: put a new battery in each battery-powered smoke alarm, and replace any alarm 10 years old or older.

item.title: Climate Pledge Arena has an event seven nights between tonight and November 7
item.description: Tonight, then October 31, November 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7; the Kraken play on November 4 and 7.

item.title: Cruise season is over at Smith Cove; Pier 91 work continues this fall
item.description: The Port's season ended Sunday, October 18, after 330 ship calls, with 66% of ships plugged into shore power at berth.

item.title: $50 off a smart thermostat, through December 31
item.description: If your home has electric baseboard or wall heaters on line-voltage thermostats, Seattle City Light takes $50 off each smart thermostat, up to five per customer, through December 31, 2026, while funding lasts.

item.title: Whether the new parking meters on Queen Anne Avenue will come with passenger load zones and disabled parking near the busiest stores
item.description: A reader on Queen Anne asked whether the new parking meters on Queen Anne Avenue will come with passenger load zones and disabled parking near the busiest stores.

item.title: Halloween on the hilltop is Saturday, October 31
item.description: The Queen Anne Farmers Market holds a Halloween Harvest Market from 10 AM to 3 PM at West Crockett Street and Queen Anne Avenue North.

item.title: Ballots are due Tuesday, November 3
item.description: No stamp is needed.

item.title: Light rail: no recap yet from Monday's forum; the next step is the Draft EIS
item.description: As of Tuesday, Sound Transit had posted nothing from the October 19 forum.

item.title: Climate Pledge Arena has an event eight of the next ten nights
item.description: Tonight, then October 23, 24, 26, 27, 28, 29 and 31; three are Kraken games.

item.title: Council budget amendments come up next week
item.description: The Select Budget Committee takes oral comment Tuesday, October 27, at 9:30 AM and discusses councilmembers' proposals October 27 to 29.

item.title: free leaf bags all November
item.description: In November, Seattle Public Utilities picks up up to 10 extra bags of leaves for free on each collection day for household food and yard waste customers.

item.title: Light rail reaches Seattle Center in 2042; Smith Cove and Interbay could wait until about 2060
item.description: Sound Transit's updated plan funds the line to Seattle Center.

item.title: Discovery Park's free beach shuttle has three weekends left
item.description: It runs Thursday to Sunday, 11 AM to 5 PM, through Sunday, November 1, looping the East, North and South lots to the beach about every 45 minutes; the last ride leaves the beach at 4:45 PM. Beach parking is ADA only, and the Visitor Center stays closed until summer 2027 after a broken water main…

item.title: The Magnolia Bridge gets inspected this fall; final design comes in spring 2028
item.description: SDOT crews are surveying the 1930 bridge, which carries 17,000 vehicles a day, ahead of concrete, steel, deck and joint repairs west of the railroad tracks.

item.title: Climate Pledge Arena has an event five of the next eight nights
item.description: Tonight, then Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and next Saturday, October 24; three are Kraken games.

item.title: The $9.1 billion city budget: two more chances to speak
item.description: Oral comment opens the Select Budget Committee on Tuesday, October 27, at 9:30 AM, and the second public hearing is Thursday, November 5 (remote from 1 PM, in person from 5 PM).

item.title: November 2, not October 31
item.description: The second half of 2026 King County property tax is due Monday, November 2.
